Outcome Mapper

Compare objectives with the course evidence that appears to teach or assess them, then review an objective-by-evidence matrix before confirming anything.

Supported scope
Competencies, outcomes and teacher-defined objectives
Design focus
Suggestions separated from confirmations
Built as a Moodle plugin first: permissions, native APIs and human review remain part of the workflow instead of being replaced by an external black box.
Practical results
Production-minded
✓
Moodle data first
PHP identifies the actual course structure, activities, assessments and optional quiz questions before AI is involved.
✓
Full mapping matrix
Semantic analysis classifies each objective-target relation as strong, probable, weak or none.

Teacher-confirmed layer

No learner performance data

What this plugin does

Outcome Mapper helps a teacher inspect whether stated learning objectives have visible teaching and assessment evidence in the course. It can combine Moodle competencies, grade outcomes and temporary text objectives entered for the analysis.

The AI never discovers course objects by itself. Moodle supplies a constrained set of normalized targets, and every relation must come back against known IDs before it can be displayed or stored as a suggestion.

Features you get
Objective-by-evidence table
Use an accessible matrix instead of depending on charts to communicate coverage.
Multiple evidence types
Compare objectives with content, activities, assessments and optional quiz questions.
Confirmation workflow
Confirm or reject positive suggestions without allowing re-analysis to overwrite human decisions.
Gap prompts
Highlight objectives that appear taught but not assessed or assessments without apparent preparation.
Stable accountability
Record who ran, confirmed or rejected mapping actions.
No official-record mutation
Never rewrite Moodle competencies or grade outcomes automatically.

Also requires AI Bridge.
